Description: The Upcycled Glassware Sprouter embodies our commitment to ethical and healthy living. It offers a delightful solution for growing nutritious sprouts effortlessly, complementing any meal.
Features: Features: Crafted from three components—an upcycled tumbler, a bioplastic lid stand, and grid—the sprouter is environmentally conscious. The bioplastic lids and grids are crafted from renewable sources, utilizing innovative technology to transform greenhouse gases into PLA material, resulting in sustainable bio-plastics and fibers.
Care:
Upcycled Tumbler: Dishwasher safe with gentle detergent.
Bioplastic Lid & Grid: Handwash with a mild scrubber and standard dishwashing liquid. Allow to air dry.
Instruction:
Prepare the seeds: Add 2-3 tablespoons of seeds to the upcycled sprouting jar and cover with a bioplastic lid. Rinse well with water, draining excess water by tilting the jar while holding the lid to prevent spillage.
Soak the seeds: Fill about half of the jar with drinking water and soak the seeds for 8 hours in summer and 10 hours in winter. After soaking, drain excess water by tilting the jar while holding the lid. Rinse, swirl, and drain again.
Sprouting process: Shake the jar and place it upside down at an angle with the help of a lid stand to allow drainage and air circulation through the lid. Rinse, swirl, and drain the seeds 2-3 times a day, ensuring they never completely dry out.
Monitor and maintain: Throughout the sprouting process, continue rinsing, swirling, and draining the seeds to promote proper drainage and air circulation for healthy growth.
Harvest and store: Once the sprouts are ready for harvest, rinse them thoroughly to remove any unsprouted seeds. Dry them thoroughly using a paper towel or clean cloth, then store in a clean, airtight container. Depending on the type of seeds, they can be refrigerated for up to 5 days.

Description: Experience the synergy of ancient wisdom and modern sustainability with our Chakra Candles. Chakra in Sanskrit means “wheel” and refers to energy points in your body. They are thought to be spinning disks of energy that should stay “open” and aligned, as they correspond to bundles of nerves, major organs, and areas of our energetic body that affect our emotional and physical well-being.
Features:
Crafted with care in Goa, India, each candle is made with natural ingredients and poured into 100% upcycled glass bottles, giving new life to objects that were once waste.
Benefits of chakra  candle
Mood Enhancement: Create a soothing atmosphere to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
Energy Balancing: Target specific chakras to release blocked energy and restore balance throughout the body.
Meditation and Mindfulness: Enhance your meditation practices by focusing on specific intentions and goals.
Spiritual Growth: Align and balance your chakras to cultivate greater clarity, self-awareness, and spiritual growth.

Choosing the right chakra candle 
Consider your intention and select a candle that corresponds to the chakra you wish to work on. Look for scents infused with essential oils that align with your desired energy center. Our candles are made from natural waxes like soy and poured into upcycled glassware for optimal results.
Care:
How to Use Chakra Candles:
Directions-Create a Peaceful Space: Set up a quiet area where you can relax and focus on your intentions.
Light the Candle: Set your intention as you light the candle, focusing on the specific chakra you want to work on.
Meditate: Close your eyes, breathe deeply, and visualize the energy flowing through the targeted chakra.
Allow the Candle to Burn: Let the candle burn for at least 30 minutes to fully release its scent and energy.
Repeat as Needed: Incorporate your chakra candle into your regular routine for ongoing balance and healing.
